name: Zymurgy
description: Not a published list: Red Sand Stage 47's deck for AgInfusion: New Miracles for a New World, on A Thousand Cuts' list, so the sweeps meet a Corp that trashes the unrezzed ice the Runner approaches and sends the run to another server's outermost ice. Eternal-legal only. Red Sand Stage 51: two Mirāju for two Neural Katana, a code gate that sends a Runner who broke it to the outermost position of Archives instead of passing it; A Thousand Cuts keeps Neural Katana. Flashpoint Stage 16 put an Enforcing Loyalty and a Psychokinesis in for its two Genotyping. FFG F6 Stage 6: two Merger and a Global Food Initiative (3 influence) for a Braintrust, a Flower Sermon and a Fujii Asset Retrieval, the same seven points, each kept by other decks. Mumbad Stage 19 swaps one Hangeki for Clones are not People.
